cd "C:/visual projects/alpha"; cat >> tools/registry/report_f.py <<'EOF'

# --- остальные механики: Δ$ после − до, по капам (cap0 = free, cap3 = B2), месяцы отдельно ---
GENERIC = (("g111_impulse_target", "Г-111 цель по импульсу (exit-sim)"), ("g118_macd_trail", "Г-118 MACD-трейл (exit-sim)"),
           ("g26_vol_family", "Г-26 семья волатильности"), ("g50_tf_boundary", "Г-50 граница ТФ"),
           ("g126_approach_brake", "Г-126 тормоз подходов"), ("p07_h14_approach_no", "П-07 H14 номер подхода"),
           ("p07_h9_pause", "П-07 H9 пауза по монете (Г-103)"))
cover = []
for pre, title in GENERIC:
    r = load(pre)
    if not r:
        continue
    for cap in ("0", "3"):
        rc = [x for x in r if x["cap"] == cap]
        pivot(f"{title}, cap{cap}: Δ$ после − до", rc, lambda x: x["point"], lambda x: float(x["sum_after"]) - float(x["sum_before"]))
for pre in ("g130_stop_round", "g144_beta_hedge", "g19_markout_rank", "g80_depth_excursion", "g18_fee_share",
            "g124_profit_throttle-cap0", "g124_profit_throttle-cap3", "g148_leverage-cap0", "g148_leverage-cap3") + tuple(p for p, _ in GENERIC):
    r = load(pre)
    pts = {x["point"] for x in r}
    ms = {x.get("month") or x.get("period") for x in r}
    cover.append((pre, len(pts), len(ms)))
r = load("g18_fee_share")
pivot("Г-18 доля издержек в |gross| (все выходы), off=0", [x for x in r if x["reason"] == "all"], lambda x: x["point"], lambda x: float(x["cost_share_of_abs_gross"]), "{:.3f}")
print("\n## Покрытие (В-224): механика — точек — месяцев\n\nмеханика | точек | месяцев из 9\n---|---|---")
for n, p, m in cover:
    print(f"{n} | {p} | {m}")
EOF
